traces.title: GET /health, idle TAP
traces.blurb: Two short HTTP/1.1 exchanges on an idle TAP. Handshake, 124 bytes of response, FIN. No delay and no loss.

traces.title: 1 MiB download, Reno
traces.blurb: curl GET /download?n=1048576 against Reno on an idle TAP. The window climbs in slow start and the transfer is not cut by loss.

traces.title: One drop, Reno
traces.blurb: 512 KiB download. 20 ms delay each way on the TAP device. Data segment 4 is dropped once. Recovery is fast retransmit, not a timeout.

traces.title: One drop, CUBIC
traces.blurb: Same forced drop and 20 ms each-way delay, with CUBIC as the congestion-avoidance increase.

traces.title: 1% loss, Reno
traces.blurb: 512 KiB download. 20 ms each-way delay and 1% random loss of non-ARP frames, Reno.

traces.title: 1% loss, CUBIC
traces.blurb: 512 KiB download. 20 ms each-way delay and 1% random loss of non-ARP frames, CUBIC.
